query:
UPDATE sessions
                SET previous_refresh_token_hash = refresh_token_hash,
                    refresh_token_hash = $3,
                    rotated_at = now(),
                    expires_at = CASE
                        WHEN $4::float8 IS NULL THEN expires_at
                        ELSE now() + make_interval(secs => $4)
                    END
                WHERE id = $1 AND refresh_token_hash = $2 AND revoked_at IS NULL
